name: Jaare-Oregim
title: Father of Elhanan from Bethlehem
summary: Jaare-Oregim from Bethlehem was the father of Elhanan, who struck down one of the Philistine giants in David's wars.

keyEvents.title: Father of the giant-slayer Elhanan
keyEvents.description: Elhanan, son of Jaare-Oregim from Bethlehem, struck down one of the Philistine giants.
